game_title: Priority Alert – Net Menders' Pier Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier, a pier of net menders: the deckhand must handle pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Priority Alert: Order elif checks correctly because only the first true branch runs.
theme: Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier: a pier of net menders
core_gameplay_loop: In Net Menders' Pier, repeat each round: Order elif checks correctly because only the first true branch runs. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the alert_accuracy value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about alert_accuracy to power up the deckhand and open the harbor gate.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 4 (applied tier): Priority Alert
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Priority Alert' (Week 3 slot 13), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Net Menders' Pier'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how alert_accuracy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against pirate raiders in Net Menders' Pier.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
